generalization_basis: Pinned constexpr promotion rule plus exact finite source AST, not inference from sampled N.

SINT32: Exact selected signed finite integer to fp32 conversion, including rounding and overflow.
UINT32: Exact unsigned finite integer or normalized bool i1 to fp32 conversion.
CMP16: Exact ordered x>=+0 comparison for every fp16 word, including NaNs and signed zero.
CMP32: Exact ordered x>=+0 comparison for every fp32 word, including NaNs and signed zero.
EXT16: Exact fp16 to fp32 extension, including specials and denormal behavior.
EXTBF16: Exact bf16 to fp32 extension at comparison and store ports.
CMP64: Concrete finite IEEE word comparison agrees with native ordered fp64 comparison.
NARROW64: Exact native fp64 to fp32 narrowing, including ties, overflow, underflow, specials and signed zero.
